feat(chat): enhance system event handling, refactor BLoC base, and improve message state management
- **System Events & Data Mapping**: - Added support for new system event types: `JOIN_CONVERSATION`, `CHANGE_BACKGROUND`, `PROMOTE_ADMIN`, and `DEMOTE_ADMIN`. - Enhanced `MessageDto` and `MessageModel` to handle system event metadata, including `actionType`, `actor` (actor details or actorId), and `targetUsers` (full profiles or IDs). - Updated `MessageMapper` and `MessageModel.toDomain()` to resolve actor and target user details for system logs. - Added debug logging in `MessageRemoteDataSource` to monitor JSON parsing of system events during development. - **BLoC Architecture**: - Refactored `BaseBloc` to provide more robust logging, error classification, and performance monitoring without emitting generic loading/error states that conflict with Freezed types. - Implemented a more resilient `executeWithRetry` utility in `BaseBloc` with localized error messages and performance tracing. - Fixed an issue in `MessageState` (Freezed) where `props` were not correctly overridden, causing BLoC to suppress UI updates due to incorrect equality checks. - **Message & Chat Logic**: - Improved `MessageBloc` resilience by re-reading state after `await` calls to prevent race conditions with background fetching or real-time events. - Implemented deduplication in `_onSendMessage` to prevent duplicate messages when real-time echoes arrive faster than the API response. - Updated `MessageBloc` to correctly apply pending conversation details (chat name, members) if they arrive before the message list is loaded. - Enhanced `ChatRepository` to fall back to local data if a server error occurs while fetching conversation details. - **GraphQL & Remote Data**: - Updated GraphQL queries in `ChatOperations` (`GetConversationMessages`, `SendMessage`, `GetMessageList`) to include system event fields (`actionType`, `targetUsers`, `newValue`, `oldValue`). - **Localization**: - Added English and Vietnamese strings for new system events: background changes and admin role management (promote/demote).
